summary: The JSON pretty-printing feature is implemented per the spec, but the tests have not been run; all verification was by reading. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; six json.* theme keys in rich/default_styles.py; a Printing JSON section in docs/source/console.rst; docs/source/reference/json.rst plus its toctree entry; a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; and a new tests/test_json.py. Choices to review: overflow is set to Python None (rich has no "none" overflow value); the CLI imports Console inside its main guard. The hand-derived ANSI expectations in test_console_print_json_styled are the most likely to need adjustment once the suite runs. Nothing was committed.
